results.title: When Will Neeraj Chopra Play Next? Indian Javelin Throw Legend Set For Blockbuster Arshad Nadeem Showdown After CWG 2026 Silver
results.description: Neeraj Chopra will return to action on August 21 after winning silver at the 2026 Commonwealth Games with a season-best throw of 85.83m. The Indian javelin star, who is recovering from a lower back injury, is set for another high-profile clash with Arshad Nadeem and a strong field of top javelin throwers. The event will also serve as an important build-up to the upcoming Asian Games. The post When Will Neeraj Chopra Play Next?
